\[
P(Foggy | Grey) = \frac{P(Grey | Foggy) \times P(Foggy)}{P(Grey)}
\]

\[

\]

So:

\[
P(Foggy | Grey) = \frac{0.68 \times 0.29}{0.4883} = \frac{0.1972}{0.4883} \approx 0.404
\]

**Answer:** About 40.4% chance the map is foggy given the grey weather icon.
